title: Cotangent complex and differential basis for a polynomial algebra
statement: Let $A$ be a commutative ring and $E$ a set. Put $P=A[x_e\mid e\in E]$. For the standard cotangent complex [lem-trf-cotangent-resolution-coherence] in $D(P)$ [def-weil-abstract-derived-category], the augmentation to universal differentials induces an isomorphism $L_{P/A}\simeq\Omega^1_{P/A}[0]$ [def-weil-pbc-kahler-differentials]. After localizing $P$, this description identifies the cotangent complex with the localized differential module in degree zero.
